description:
Score a package against the real outliers on its subject, part by part (title device,
    length, words on the picture, faces, the words' role, contrast, brightness): each part
    says how many outliers it matches; pattern_match (0 to 100) is the mean share: how much
    the package resembles the subject's outliers, never a click-through rate or a prediction
    (in our test it scored outliers above their channels' usual videos on about 3 of 4 pairs). Also nearest (5 outliers) and fixes. 1 credit, refunded when the read
    fails. Same as POST /v1/packaging/score.

content_type.description: for a topic: long or short
content_type.title: Content Type

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

run_id.description: a finished run of yours whose outliers to compare with; or topic
run_id.title: Run Id

thumbnail.description: optional: your thumbnail as base64 (JPEG, PNG, WebP, at most 4 MB) or an i.ytimg.com URL
thumbnail.title: Thumbnail

video_url.description: a published YouTube video to score instead
video_url.title: Video Url
